parsed.explanation: No trans-presentation offence or universal facility ban is documented, but if outed a visitor faces tier-2 state-tolerated targeting: routine police detention on pretexts, on-the-spot extortion, detention beyond constitutional period, trumped charges and reported rape by security officers, documented across interviews and human-rights reports, with the most recent abuse in the 2025 incarceration case involving nonconsensual medical procedures and court-ordered gender determination. Same-sex criminalisation (up to 14 years, upheld 2019, appeal unresolved) is not tangential here because police use it and related pretexts as extortion lever, though it is secondary to trans-specific policing. Custody placement remains unresolved and prison treatment was found to violate dignity. Mitigating: courts have repeatedly ruled for trans/LGBT claimants (2018 forced-examination ban, 2024 compensation, 2023 association, 2025 and 2026 marker judgment) and a 2024 killer received 50 years, showing recourse sometimes works, but no implementing anti-discrimination statute is recorded and no remedy for routine extortion is shown. No trans-specific violence rate exists, so magnitude is unknown.
